claims.claim: On 8 October the team posted that Scott Shawyer will not start the Route du Rhum due to an energy-systems failure, a compressed qualification window, and seasickness in the English Channel.
claims.episode_span: On 8 October the team posted that Scott Shawyer will not start the Route du Rhum. The post details an energy-systems failure on the delivery back from Canada that limited the boat's function, a compressed qualification window once the systems were restored, and seasickness that struck while Shawyer worked on the onboard computer in 25 knots upwind in the English Channel.
claims.supporting_quote: When you and the team have worked hard to prepare for a major event, not making it to the start line is incredibly difficult.
